scientific_question: When geographic graph connectivity predicts mapped island occurrence, can that connectivity be distinguished from time-ordered realized colonization driven by independently modelled physical transport and lagged viable sources?
limitation: This is cross-system mechanism triage, NOT independent validation of original IUCN-derived mammal predictions, and no new effect is estimated.

published_comparators.source_type: repeated point-call wetland occupancy with nondetection records
published_comparators.prior_outcome_exposure: Van Schmidt and Beissinger (2020) directly showed recolonization rescue and limits of isolation-extinction inference; separate 2022 publication reused overlapping long-term rails systems
published_comparators.primary_limit: Site-level coordinates/network availability and site-specific transition denominators not yet certified; published source/turnover findings make pristine confirmatory status unavailable

published_comparators.source_type: 813 eDNA water samples across two surveyed years and 190 estuary habitats
published_comparators.prior_outcome_exposure: Published occupancy dynamics and positive occupied-neighbour effects on colonization
published_comparators.primary_limit: Only two survey seasons, low published colonization chance, published network treated as a spatial model rather than observed movement

published_comparators.source_type: semiannual patch-level area/biomass/fecundity series paired with directional ocean circulation model transport times
published_comparators.published_network: ROMS ocean currents particle simulations; transport edges MODELLED, not directly observed spore dispersal
published_comparators.science_advantage: has ecological source production state and a physically based directed transport operator alongside next-period patch dynamics
published_comparators.published_prior: Castorani et al. 2015 already linked connectivity to extinction and colonization; Castorani et al. 2017 already contrasted time-varying source fecundity and modeled dispersal.
published_comparators.overlap_risk: Same kelp metapopulation, repeated articles and versioned datasets must be treated as one overlapping biological lineage, not independent replications.

mechanism_comparison.ecological_claim_under_test: Temporal colonization signal is generated by directional transport weighted by active propagule-producing sources, not by geography-only nearest-neighbour topology per se.

hypothesis_labels.H_GEO: Geographic smoothness: source-conditioned kNN and Euclidean distance capture most time-ordered transition information; directed transport and viable source state add little.
hypothesis_labels.H_MOVE: Directional transfer: source-to-target ocean transport adds next-transition information above geographic geometry, source abundance and habitat after time-respecting evaluation, especially for patch pairs where transport and Euclidean expectations disagree.
hypothesis_labels.H_SOURCE: Source competence: time-varying source fecundity adds predictive information while a time-varying ocean transport representation offers little beyond stable geographic opportunity.
hypothesis_labels.H_BOTH: Joint bottleneck: colonization is greatest only when source production is positive AND source-to-target physical transport is favourable; this interaction adds beyond separate main effects.
hypothesis_labels.H_LOCAL: Local patch habitat (substrate/heat/wave/etc.) absorbs the apparent connectivity increment after properly lagged covariates.

outcome_separation.colonization: 0 at semester t -> 1 at t+1, conditioning on recorded patch observation state at t
outcome_separation.local_extinction: 1 at semester t -> 0 at t+1, separately scored
outcome_separation.detection_and_survey_process: must be verified and modelled/qualified before endpoint qualification

pre_outcome_reference_ladder: R0: local patch area, environmental and survey context from <=t, season/time and geography
R1: R0 + geographic occupied-source distance/abundance from t only
G: R1 + coordinate-derived kNN paths from t, no biological edge assumption
T: R1 + separately modelled directional physical transport from sources at t
F: R1 + lagged source patch fecundity/viability at t
TF: R1 + both T and F, and their preregistered joint interaction
mechanism_comparison.reason_confirmatory_not_authorized: Aggregate results of the source ecosystem were already published, source file versions need reconciliation, physical currents are modelled, and the v0.31/v0.42 burned pilot admission has not been met.

next_metadata_only_gate: Verify authoritative DOI and exact version for both patch states and transport, without opening ecological values
Check source archive roles and predeclare exact patch ID, transport origin-destination IDs and time windows
Require a verified lagged t->t+1 alignment and separate observation denominator
Register overlapping Castorani 2015/2017 studies as one biological lineage, not two independent replications
If those prerequisites fail, STOP; otherwise keep retrospective design-exposed status until a truly new system passes normal v0.31/v0.42 requirements
